rationale: The agent located the user and relevant orders and computed the total price difference correctly ($107.09). However, it submitted two exchange requests and charged a payment method without first obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The user had asked to know the total due; the agent should have presented the amount and requested confirmation before executing exchanges. Acting on the user’s own orders appears correct, but the lack of pre-write confirmation makes this a fail.
